question: Who among the following was the first person in British India to get the scholarship of Indian Society of Oriental Arts, established in 1906?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Nandalal Bose**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] __Key Points__

__
 
• **Nandalal Bose** was a pioneering Indian painter and a key figure in modern Indian art.
 
• He was a disciple of Abanindranath Tagore, the founder of the Bengal school of art.
 
• Bose was closely associated with the Indian Society of Oriental Art, established in 1906, and was the first recipient of its scholarship.
 
• He is renowned for his contribution to the Indian independence movement through his art, and his works are considered masterpieces of Indian art.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Indian Society of Oriental Art**

 
 
• Founded in 1906, the Indian Society of Oriental Art was established to promote and support Indian art and culture.
 
• It played a crucial role in the revival of traditional Indian art forms during the early 20th century.
 
• The society provided scholarships and support to young artists, fostering the development of a new generation of Indian artists.
 
• It aimed to create an awareness and appreciation of Indian art both in India and internationally.
 
 
 
• **Nandalal Bose's Contributions**
 
 
• Nandalal Bose was instrumental in the design of the Indian constitution's original manuscript, illustrating its pages with images from Indian mythology and history.
 
• He served as the principal of Kala Bhavana, the art school at Visva-Bharati University in Santiniketan, founded by Rabindranath Tagore.
 
• His works include the famous Haripura posters, which were used to inspire and rally people during the Indian independence movement.
 
• In recognition of his contributions, Bose was awarded the Padma Vibhushan, India's second-highest civilian award, in 1954.
 
 
 
• **Other Notable Personalities Mentioned**
 
 
• **Jagdish Chandra Bose**: A pioneering scientist in the field of radio and microwave optics, as well as a biologist who conducted significant research on plant physiology.
 
• **Subrahmanyan Chandrasekhar**: An astrophysicist who won the Nobel Prize in Physics for his work on the structure and evolution of stars.
 
• **Prafulla Chandra Roy**: A renowned chemist and founder of Bengal Chemicals & Pharmaceuticals, India's first pharmaceutical company.
